name: uniminuto.edu
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 213 form controls have no label.
lesson: Give every input a visible label tied to it with for and id. Screen readers announce it, and the tap target grows.
summary: www.uniminuto.edu scores 63 out of 100 (D). 8 checks fail now, 28 are at risk, and 23 pass. Fix first: 213 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 213 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /noticias/columna-de-nuestro-rector-padre-harold-castilla-devoz-comprender-hacia-atras-decidir-hacia, /oferta-academica, /encuentra-tu-sede and 96 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Buttons must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 12 elements on /, /noticias/columna-de-nuestro-rector-padre-harold-castilla-devoz-comprender-hacia-atras-decidir-hacia, /oferta-academica, for example .s-sliderSteps > .owl-dots > .owl-dot[role="button"]:nth-child(1) and…
fix.fix: Give each icon button visible text or an aria-label.

fix.title: 285 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 99 elements on /, /noticias/columna-de-nuestro-rector-padre-harold-castilla-devoz-comprender-hacia-atras-decidir-hacia, /oferta-academica, for example .no-dics > li:nth-child(4) > a[target="_blank"] and .no-dics > li:nth-child(5) >…
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: <li> elements must be contained in a <ul> or <ol>
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 20 elements on /noticias/columna-de-nuestro-rector-padre-harold-castilla-devoz-comprender-hacia-atras-decidir-hacia, for example .cloned.owl-item:nth-child(1) > .no-dics and .cloned.owl-item:nth-child(2) > .no-dics. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Put each li inside a ul or ol.

fix.title: Elements must only use supported ARIA attributes
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 2 elements on /, for example .item_type3 > .nolink.dropdown-toggle[aria-haspopup="true"] and .item_type1 > .nolink.dropdown-toggle[aria-haspopup="true"]. Impact: critical.
